fields.label: Input/output options
fields.helpText: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

fields.label: Sample Set Name
fields.helpText: Name identifier for this sample set (e.g., 'brugada', 'cohort1')
Name identifier for this sample set (e.g., 'brugada', 'cohort1'). MUST not contain spaces or special characters (eg. _).

fields.label: VCF files
fields.helpText: VCF files that will be used as input for analysis

fields.label: Scoring File Options
fields.helpText: Choose ONE of the following methods to provide scoring files: upload a tar file with 1 or more scoring files (manually edited in pgscalc-format), or specify PGS Catalog IDs to download. If a target, focused report is desired in addition to the overall one, you must specify the 'Subset PGS IDs for additional report' section below.

fields.label: Scorefile Tar File (Upload)
fields.helpText: Tar file containing one or more scoring files in PGS Catalog format. Alternative to using PGS Catalog IDs below.

fields.label: PGS Score IDs (Download)
fields.helpText: Comma-separated list of PGS score IDs to download from PGS Catalog, e.g. PGS000802,PGS000001. Alternative to uploading scorefile folder above.

fields.label: Subset PGS IDs for additional report
fields.helpText: Optional: comma-separated PGS IDs to produce an additional subset report and CSV (e.g., PGS000802,PGS000001). If a manual tar file is supplied, the score labels passed here must match the metadata in the tar file. Leave empty to skip.

fields.label: Patient Report Template
fields.helpText: Quarto template file (.qmd) for generating patient reports

fields.label: FontAwesome Font File
fields.helpText: Optional FontAwesome font file (.ttf) for displaying person icons in reports. If not provided, circles will be used instead.

fields.label: outdir
fields.helpText: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

fields.label: copy_genomes
fields.helpText: Copy harmonised genomes (plink2 pgen/pvar/psam files) to outdir

fields.label: Compatibility options
fields.helpText: Define parameters that control how scoring files and target genomes are made compatible with each other

fields.label: target_build
fields.helpText: Genome build of target genomes, eg. GRCh38

fields.label: liftover
fields.helpText: Lift scoring files to match your target genomes. Requires build information in the header of the scoring files.

fields.label: min_lift
fields.helpText: Minimum proportion of variants required to successfully remap a scoring file to a different genome build.

fields.label: Matching options
fields.helpText: Define how variants are matched across scoring files and target genomes.

fields.label: keep_multiallelic
fields.helpText: Allow matches of scoring file variants to multiallelic variants in the target dataset

fields.label: keep_ambiguous
fields.helpText: Keep matches of scoring file variants to strand ambiguous variants (e.g. A/T and C/G SNPs) in the target dataset. This assumes the scoring file and target dataset report variants on the same strand.

fields.label: min_overlap
fields.helpText: Minimum proportion of variants present in both the score file and input target genomic data

fields.label: Genetic ancestry options
fields.helpText: Parameters used to control genetic ancestry similarity analysis on TARGET samples and variants included in PCA

fields.label: projection_method
fields.helpText: The method for PCA prediction. oadp: most accurate. adp: accurate but slow. sp: fast but inaccurate.

fields.label: ancestry_method
fields.helpText: Method used for population/ancestry assignment

fields.label: ref_label
fields.helpText: Population labels in reference psam to use for assignment

fields.label: n_popcomp
fields.helpText: Number of PCs used for population assignment

fields.label: normalization_method
fields.helpText: Method used for normalisation of genetic ancestry

fields.label: n_normalization
fields.helpText: Number of PCs used for population normalisation

fields.label: load_afreq
fields.helpText: Load allelic frequencies from reference panel when scoring target genomes

fields.label: pca_maf_target
fields.helpText: Minimum MAF threshold in TARGET samples for variants to be included in the PCA.

fields.label: pca_geno_miss_target
fields.helpText: Maximum genotype missingness threshold in TARGET samples for variants to be included in the PCA.

fields.label: Reference options
fields.helpText: Define how genomes and variants in REFERENCE panel are defined and processed for PCA

fields.label: run_ancestry
fields.helpText: Path to reference database. Must be set to adjust for genetic ancestry differences between the scoring file and target genomes.

fields.label: hg19_chain
fields.helpText: Path to a UCSC chain file for converting from hg19 to hg38.  Needed if lifting over a custom scoring file.

fields.label: hg38_chain
fields.helpText: Path to a UCSC chain file for converting from hg38 to hg19.  Needed if lifting over a custom scoring file.

fields.label: geno_ref
fields.helpText: Exclude VARIANTS with percentage of missing genotype calls greater than a threshold (in reference genomes)

fields.label: mind_ref
fields.helpText: Exclude SAMPLES with percentage of missing genotype calls greater than a threshold (in reference genomes)

fields.label: maf_ref
fields.helpText: Exclude variants with minor allele frequency (MAF) lower than a threshold (in reference genomes)

fields.label: hwe_ref
fields.helpText: Exclude variants with Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium exact test p-values below  a threshold (in reference genomes)

fields.label: indep_pairwise_ref
fields.helpText: Used to generate a list of variants in approximate linkage equilibrium in reference genomes. Window size - step size - unphased hardcall r^2 threshold.

fields.label: ld_grch37
fields.helpText: Path to a file that contains areas of high linkage disequilibrium in the reference data (build GRCh37).

fields.label: ld_grch38
fields.helpText: Path to a file that contains areas of high linkage disequilibrium in the reference data (build GRCh38).

fields.label: ref_format_version
fields.helpText: Version of the default reference database

fields.label: ancestry_checksums
fields.helpText: Used to validate files in the reference database when built
